name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Ilhan Kyuchyuk
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided not to lift the legal immunity of Ilhan Kyuchyuk, a Member of the European Parliament elected in Bulgaria. The European Public Prosecutor's Office asked for this waiver so it could investigate him over alleged misuse of European Union funds, including claims about how his local assistants were paid. Parliament refused, saying the investigation looks politically motivated and aimed at damaging his work as a Member.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Kyuchyuk keeps his immunity, so the prosecutors cannot pursue him for now.
- **Who it affects:** Ilhan Kyuchyuk and the European Public Prosecutor's Office investigating him.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the prosecutors and to Kyuchyuk.
